text: I have been contacted by a local businesses, a recording studio, who have been having persistent issues with their loading area being blocked. Their loading area is a legal boulevard parking spot that is often blocked by illegal parking. Transportation Services has provided language to change the regulations on this short stretch to “No-Stopping” which would ensure that this access is maintained. I look forward to your support for these recommendations.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Logan Avenue, between Eastern Avenue and a point 30 metres south.
